_comment: MCP servers Claude Code loads at startup. Remove unused server blocks before starting Claude Code. Secrets and identifiers are read from .env via ${VAR} expansion where supported. Restart Claude Code after changing this file or .env.

figma._comment: Optional. Designer Agent uses this only when project_setup/step_3_design/ has no usable local files.

github._comment: DevOps Agent. Required for automatic repo/CI work after deployment approval. GITHUB_TOKEN must target the existing repo and allow Contents read/write, Workflows read/write, and Actions read.

vercel._comment: DevOps Agent. Required for automatic web deploys. Keep only when web deployment is in scope. VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_TEAM_SLUG, and VERCEL_PROJECT_SLUG must point to an existing Vercel project.

supabase._comment: Optional for Supabase projects. TechLead/DEV/Flutter use this for schema inspection, migrations, and seeding. Remove if the project does not use Supabase.
